biotools.summary: LBFextract is a Python package designed for feature extraction from circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) data, facilitating the integration of preprocessing and postprocessing steps and enabling biomarker discovery by inferring transcription factor activity. It provides a comprehensive suite of tools to streamline liquid biopsy data analysis.
biotools.name: LBFextract
